core.observation: strictly increasing timestamp vector and row-major samples with unique sensor declarations
core.missing: exclude unavailable coordinates via a mask common to all candidates and offsets
core.nuisance: one shared integer-grid offset; no interpolation or amplitude fitting
core.decision: observation deadline cut before residual evaluation; templates must be available in advance

scales.development: nominal SID 213 NORMAL RMS strictly before 1000 s

methods.B3: matched residual shared shift, equal per-channel weight
methods.B4: B3 plus equal total weight for pressure and flow in the declared subset
